title: Kettle Simmered German Beef Stew
description: A savory and comforting German dish featuring beef stock and tadka, made in a kazan cauldron, perfect for a cold winter's night, this jain-friendly stew is a hearty and flavorful meal

ingredients.name: tadka spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat the beef stock in the kazan cauldron over medium heat
Add the sliced carrots, cubed potatoes, chopped onions, minced garlic, and chopped celery to the cauldron
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes
Add the tomato paste and tadka spices to the cauldron and stir to combine
Continue to simmer the stew for another 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
